lcc_original: 要做發光之體在天穹裏，來照在地上；』就這樣成了。
notes: LCC 要做 corresponds to UNV 並要 — 做 captures the verbal sense of H1961 (הָיָה, to be/become)
LCC 發光之體 (luminous bodies) expands UNV 發光 but maps to the same H3974 (מָאוֹר, luminary)
LCC 天穹 (celestial dome) is a single compound covering both H8064 (שָׁמַיִם, heavens) and H7549 (רָקִיעַ, firmament); all three SNs attached to the compound
裏 is a Chinese locative particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 來照 (come to illuminate) replaces UNV 普照 (illuminate everywhere) but maps to same H0215 (אוֹר, to give light)
